items.html: And these two aspects are Yosef and Binyamin: one is Mayin Nukvin, and it is the source of the well that never separates from the well. And one is Mayin Dechurin, in the secret of 'Yosef the Righteous — he is above and he is below; he enters and goes out: he enters to bring in Mayin Dechurin, and goes out to bring out Mayin Nukvin to receive Mayin Dechurin.' And this is every time that there is a coupling. And as is stated in the portion Vayetze, page 155, column 1, and this is its language: 'But come, see the secret of the matter: at all times the Righteous goes out and enters from the lower world — through it he enters, and from it he goes out, etc.' — end of his language.
